card.text: TOI-715 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-715 b"
sources.quote: TOI-715 b is a super-Earth exoplanet in the habitable zone of its parent M-type star, TOI-715.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-715. Its orbit and size follow Dransfield et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Dransfield et al. 2024
sources.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DRANSFIELD_ET_AL_2024): disc_year 2023, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 19.288004, pl_radj 0.13828198, pl_bmassj 0.00951

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-715 b"
sources.quote: The planet is 1.55 times larger than Earth, and is located at 0.083 astronomical units (12,400,000 km) from its star.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
